caption: A green spotlight is aimed at a white marble statue in a garden at night, and the statue appears green.

sa.check: A statue stands in a garden.
A green spotlight is aimed at it.

pc.expect: The statue looks green only where the beam falls and while it is on.
pc.fail: It is green with the light off; or stays white under the green beam; or turns a different colour.

pc.expect: The change is confined to where the beam falls and happens with the light.
pc.fail: Parts outside the beam turn green; or the statue changes before the light; or long after.

pc.expect: The statue's shape and shading show in green, not as a colour change of the marble.
pc.fail: Parts are a different colour; or the statue is flat green with no shading; or the statue changes shape.

pc.expect: Nothing moves; only the light changes.
pc.fail: The statue moves; or the spotlight swings by itself; or the lit area wanders.
A second statue appears; or the spotlight vanishes; or the light becomes solid.
The plants rearrange; or the plinth changes; or the spotlight changes shape.
